# Tone Event

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ToneEvent`](gmeow-ToneEvent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ToneEvent>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The one structural subkind of [`MusicalSegment`](gmeow-MusicalSegment.md) — an atomic sounding unit with pitch content (a [`PitchValue`](gmeow-PitchValue.md), a [`PitchTrajectory`](gmeow-PitchTrajectory.md), or unpitched), a duration via [`segmentSpan`](../properties/gmeow-segmentSpan.md), and optional parameters such as dynamics and articulation.
